structure.unit: Foreign Savings Institutions; Acquisitions by Out-Of-State Savings Institutions or Out-Of-State Savings Institution Holding Companies

law.catch_line: Revocation of certificate of authority of foreign savings institution

text.section: The Commission may also revoke the certificate of authority of a foreign savings institution at any time that the Commission determines that the state where the principal place of business of the foreign savings institution is located has enacted or amended its laws or regulations, or taken administrative action, so as to prohibit or unfairly impede a state association or state savings bank from transacting business in that state.
